A repository for storing artifacts

| Tier | 1 (ruled: One hook is scope resolution this provider already performs, and the other hand-writes mask paths that buildNested produces natively.
encoder (encoders/location_from_region.go.tmpl) defaults `location` from the provider's `region` when the resource does not set it. `location` is a URL segment here (projects/*/locations/*/repositories), not a body field, and filling scope segments from instance configuration is what gcprov.Provider.withScope does for every type. Same job, done earlier.
pre_update (update_encoder/artifact_registry_repository_update.go.tmpl, wired as pre_update) re-expands `remoteRepositoryConfig` into the body and then appends two DEEP mask paths by hand -- remoteRepositoryConfig.upstreamCredentials.usernamePasswordCredentials.username and .passwordSecretVersion -- before rewriting the updateMask query parameter. Terraform needs this because its own diff does not reach that far down a nested block. BuildMask's buildNested recurses through every declared Fields level and emits exactly these dotted paths for the leaves that changed (internal/gcprov/patch.go), and the mask goes on the query string the same way, so the generic path reaches the same request.
Unblocks gcp.artifactregistry.rule, gcp.artifactregistry.tag and gcp.attachment, all three of which ship and all three of which hang off a repository.

| Operation | Supported | How |

| Create | yes | `POST projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/repositories?repository_id={{repository_id}}` |
| Read | yes | `GET projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/repositories/{{repository_id}}` |
| Update | yes | `PATCH projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/repositories/{{repository_id}}`, with an update mask naming the changed fields |
| Delete | yes | `DELETE projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/repositories/{{repository_id}}` |
